title: 揭秘Anthropic的「暴利」真相：缓存税
content: The article debunks the perception of Anthropic's AI subscriptions as unprofitable, revealing that coding agents generate high revenue through "cache taxes." KV caching renders context re-reads computationally cheap, while speculative decoding optimizes output generation. Although subscribers access extensive token limits, the true inference cost remains low. This structural inefficiency allows Anthropic to profit significantly from enterprise API users paying for cache reads, while maintaining high margins for individual subscribers.

title: OpenAI 用 GPT 优化 AMD 旗舰 GPU 电路，相关设计已送流片
content: OpenAI utilized GPT models to rewrite SystemVerilog RTL code for AMD’s flagship GPU. Within five months, this optimization achieved up to a 14% net improvement in power, performance, and area (PPA). The AI-driven design, demonstrating expert-level microarchitecture reasoning, has been sent to the fab. The technology was previously validated on OpenAI’s “Chili” chip. Additionally, OpenAI is collaborating with Synopsys to train models capable of directly operating electronic design automation (EDA) tools, aiming to accelerate autonomous silicon iteration.
